en.analysis.help.title: Equipment analysis guide
en.analysis.help.gearBody: Groups Rangers by type and element, then shows the proportion whose equipment high-level option can activate.
en.analysis.help.surehitBody: Shows the proportion of Rangers with a weapon that has both reduced Ranger regeneration time and Skill Surehit Rate, plus the stat required for their type below. Flying Rangers are excluded.
en.analysis.help.int: Intelligence: the weapon must include Overall ATK.
en.analysis.help.agi: Agility: the weapon must include Overall ATK or Physical ATK.
en.analysis.help.str: Strength: the weapon must include HP.
en.analysis.help.elementBody: Shows the proportion of Rangers whose equipment has an active Elemental Prowess high-level option. Only Intelligence and Agility Rangers are counted; flying Rangers are excluded.
